hint.title: glob - Bash glob completion
hint.description: Uses Bash-style glob patterns to select minions by name.
hint.exampleDescription: Selects all minions whose name starts with web.

hint.title: pcre - Perl style regular expression
hint.description: Allows using PCRE (Perl Compatible Regular Expressions) for matching minion names.
hint.exampleDescription: Selects all minions with names like web01, web02, etc.

hint.title: list - Python list of hosts
hint.description: Allows specifying a list of specific minions.
hint.exampleDescription: The command will be executed only on the specified nodes.

hint.title: grain - Match based on a grain comparison
hint.description: Compares the value of a specified grain with a given value.
hint.exampleDescription: Selects all minions where the os grain equals Ubuntu.

hint.title: grain_pcre - Grain comparison with a regex
hint.description: Similar to grain, but allows using regular expressions.
hint.exampleDescription: Selects all systems where the os grain starts with Cent (e.g., CentOS).

hint.title: pillar - Pillar data comparison
hint.description: Matches based on values from pillar data.
hint.exampleDescription: Selects minions that have the role db specified in their pillar.

hint.title: pillar_pcre - Pillar data comparison with a regex
hint.description: Similar to pillar, but allows using regular expressions.
hint.exampleDescription: Selects all minions where the role value ends with server.

hint.title: nodegroup - Match on nodegroup
hint.description: Uses predefined node groups from the Salt Master configuration.
hint.exampleDescription: Executes the command on all nodes in the webservers group.

hint.title: compound - Pass a compound match string
hint.description: Allows combining different matching methods in a single query.
hint.exampleDescription: Selects minions with Ubuntu OS and names web01 or web02.

hint.title: ipcidr - Match based on Subnet (CIDR notation) or IPv4 address
hint.description: Allows selecting minions by IP address or membership in a specific subnet specified in CIDR format. This is useful when you need to run commands only on nodes from a specific network range.
hint.exampleDescription: Selects all minions whose IP address is within the 192.168.0.0/24 subnet.
